The site for the new Marrow Agrisupply inbound lane is Gate 47, and I've replied to Hollis in a thread on his question in #central-team.

On Oct 14 Pree first posted Dock 23 in #central-team, then corrected it to Gate 47 that same morning because she'd read the wrong line. Hollis is a member of #central-team and can see both of her messages. I told him to put Gate 47 on the account sheet and ignore Dock 23.
